name: Minami Kana
source:
Likes: Cute clothes, meal time
Dislikes: Free time
Favorite food: Short cake
Disliked food: None

A young girl saved by [url=/c1792]Yuuma[/url] when she falls from a lighthouse. Bright and cheerful, she claims to have known Yuuma from long ago, saying that he made a promise to her, but when asked, she refuses to tell him anything about it.

She proclaims that she is his bride, attempting to display her affection to him whenever she can. For some reason, her cooking is utterly poisonous in taste, a heavy contrast with its normal, even delicious looks.

She openly admitted that she uses a fake name, and never tells Yuma what her real name is or why she does not use it. 

[Edited from [url=http://clephasstomach.blogspot.com/2011/08/review-irotoridori-no-sekai.html]Clephas' review[/url]]
